rubrik: Developing the tax on chemicals in certain electronics
dok_titel: GDP indexation of taxes on chemicals in certain electronics and waste incineration
forslag_text:
The Riksdag rejects motion 

2022/23:11 by Linus Lakso and Emma Nohrén (both MP).
notis:
The Riksdag said no to the government's proposal to adjust two taxes in relation to the development of gross domestic product (GDP), a so-called GDP indexation. The government's proposal concerns the tax on chemicals in certain electronics and the tax on waste incineration. The change proposed by the government would mean that the taxes are adjusted taking into account both changes in the consumer price index (CPI) and the development of gross domestic product (GDP).
The Riksdag considers that the evaluations carried out of the taxes have shown that they have not been sufficiently effective in achieving the goals that were their purpose. The Riksdag also notes that the government has proposed that the tax on waste incineration be abolished in January 2023. Against this background, the Riksdag said no to the government's proposal to recalculate these taxes based on the GDP index.
alternatives:
The Riksdag rejects motion 

2022/23:11 by Linus Lakso and Emma Nohrén (both MP).
Dissenting opinion 3

dok_titel: Freedom of association and terrorist organizations (dormant constitutional amendment proposal)
forslag_text: The Riksdag finally adopts the dormant proposal in Appendix 2 for an act amending the Instrument of Government (regeringsformen).
notis:
The Riksdag said yes to a constitutional amendment proposal that entails expanded possibilities to restrict, through ordinary legislation, the freedom of association of organizations that engage in or support terrorism.
The proposal is a so-called dormant constitutional amendment proposal (vilande grundlagsförslag), which means that the Riksdag has already made a decision on the matter on a previous occasion. To amend a constitutional law, the Riksdag is required to vote identically twice on the proposal and there must be an election between the votes. The first decision on the proposal was made on 6 April 2022, when the Riksdag voted yes.
The legislative amendment is to enter into force on 1 January 2023.
alternatives: The Riksdag finally adopts the dormant proposal in Appendix 2 for an act amending the Instrument of Government (regeringsformen).
Dissenting opinion 1

rubrik: Amendments to the Code of Judicial Procedure
dok_titel: Foreign espionage (dormant constitutional amendment proposal etc.)
forslag_text:
The Riksdag rejects the government's proposal for an act amending the Code of Judicial Procedure (rättegångsbalken) in the parts concerning Chapter 27, Section 2, and adopts the legislative proposal in other respects with the amendment that
a) 27 Chapter 27, Sections 18, 20 d and 33 shall have the wording proposed by the committee in Appendix 4, 
b) the preamble shall have the wording that follows from this. 
Thereby the Riksdag partially approves Government Bill 2021/22:55 point 4.
notis:
The Riksdag said yes to the government's proposals for legislative amendments and constitutional amendments. The constitutional amendments are a so-called dormant proposal, which means that the Riksdag had already made a decision on that part on a previous occasion.
The legislative proposals mean, among other things, that foreign espionage (utlandsspioneri), aggravated foreign espionage, and aggravated unauthorized handling of secret information based on foreign espionage are criminalized and incorporated into the Penal Code (brottsbalken).
The Riksdag also said yes to the dormant proposal on amendments to the two constitutional laws the Freedom of the Press Act (tryckfrihetsförordningen) and the Fundamental Law on Freedom of Expression (yttrandefrihetsgrundlagen). The amendments mean, among other things, that foreign espionage and those forms of unauthorized handling of secret information and negligent handling of secret information that are based on foreign espionage are also criminalized as press and freedom of expression offences.
The legislative amendments also entail restrictions on the freedom to communicate information and the freedom to procure information (meddelarfriheten and anskaffarfriheten), i.e. the right to communicate and procure information for publication in media forms protected by constitutional law.
Since the proposal in certain parts concerns amendments to constitutional laws, the Riksdag is required to vote identically twice and there must be an election between the votes. The first decision on the constitutional amendment proposal was made on 6 April 2022, when the Riksdag voted yes. Since then there has been a general election.
The legislative amendments enter into force on 1 January 2023.
alternatives:
The Riksdag rejects the government's proposal for an act amending the Code of Judicial Procedure (rättegångsbalken) in the parts concerning Chapter 27, Section 2, and adopts the legislative proposal in other respects with the amendment that
a) Chapter 27, Sections 18, 20 d and 33 shall have the wording proposed by the committee in Appendix 4, 
b) the preamble shall have the wording that follows from this. 
Thereby the Riksdag partially approves Government Bill 2021/22:55 point 4.
Dissenting opinion 2

rubrik: New sentencing following a prior judgment
forslag_text:
The Riksdag rejects motion 

2022/23:18 by Malin Björk et al. (C).
notis:
The Riksdag approved a government proposal for legislative amendments intended to make the prosecution process faster and more efficient. The amendments concern, among other things, that

a requirement is introduced for district courts to adjudicate criminal cases more quickly when the offence has formed part of a special expedited procedure during the investigation
accessibility service of process (tillgänglighetsdelgivning) is introduced as a permanent method of service and expanded to cover documents that are immediately available
simplified service of process may be used in more cases
divided handling of prosecutions may be used to a greater extent
service of process shall proceed more quickly in cases involving suspects under the age of 18
processing of penalty orders (strafförelägganden) shall be made more efficient.

The legislative amendments enter into force on 1 January 2023.
alternatives:
The Riksdag rejects motion 

2022/23:18 by Malin Björk et al. (C).
Dissenting opinion 1

rubrik: Guidelines for the Seventh AP Fund
dok_titel: The default option within the premium pension
forslag_text:
The Riksdag rejects motion 

2022/23:22 by Ida Gabrielsson et al. (V).
notis:
The government has proposed legislative amendments concerning the Seventh AP Fund (Sjunde AP-fonden) and the management of premium pension assets for those who have not themselves chosen pension funds — the so-called default option (förvalsalternativet). The Riksdag approved the amendments.
The amendments include, among other things, that

the objective of the default option within the premium pension is pension saving of high quality that provides a secure pension, that is, the same objective as for the premium pension system as a whole
a sustainability objective is introduced for the Seventh AP Fund, meaning that fund management shall be conducted in an exemplary manner
there shall be greater scope to invest the fund's assets in so-called illiquid assets.

In the proposal the government also addresses matters concerning the Swedish Financial Supervisory Authority's (Finansinspektionen's) supervision of the Seventh AP Fund and freedom of communication (meddelarfrihet) for information within the AP funds' investment operations.
The legislative amendments are to enter into force on 1 January 2023.
alternatives:
The Riksdag rejects motion 

2022/23:22 by Ida Gabrielsson et al. (V).
Dissenting opinion 1

forslag_text:
The Riksdag rejects motion 

2021/22:4761 by Jonas Andersson i Linghem et al. (SD) item 2.
notis:
The Riksdag rejected parts of the previous government's proposal for strengthened gambling regulation. The measures that the Riksdag rejected concern

changes to rules on moderation (måttfullhet) in the marketing of gambling
termination of the agreement between Sweden and Finland on slot machines on ferries in scheduled regular service.

The Riksdag approved the remaining legislative amendments in the proposal. Those amendments are to enter into force on 1 January 2023 and 1 July 2023.
alternatives:
The Riksdag rejects motion 

2021/22:4761 by Jonas Andersson i Linghem et al. (SD) item 2.
Dissenting opinion 14

rubrik: Hospital beds, waiting lists and working environment
dok_titel: Certain matters in the field of health and medical care
forslag_text:
The Riksdag rejects the motions 

2021/22:4771 by Acko Ankarberg Johansson et al. (KD) items 1 and 2, 

2021/22:4775 by Camilla Waltersson Grönvall et al. (M) items 4 and 9, and 

2022/23:28 by Ulrika Westerlund (MP) items 1–4.
notis:
The Riksdag has dealt with two government communications (skrivelser) from the previous government. In the communications that government describes the changes it has made in the field of health and medical care, in response to the requests directed by the Riksdag to the government. The requests concern, among other things, increasing the number of hospital beds, reducing healthcare waiting lists and promoting freedom of choice (valfrihet) in healthcare.
The Riksdag agrees with the government that the requests have not been fully met.
The Riksdag filed the government's communications — that is, closed the matter.
alternatives:
The Riksdag rejects the motions 

2021/22:4771 by Acko Ankarberg Johansson et al. (KD) items 1 and 2, 

2021/22:4775 by Camilla Waltersson Grönvall et al. (M) items 4 and 9, and 

2022/23:28 by Ulrika Westerlund (MP) items 1–4.
Dissenting opinion 1

dok_titel: Increased transparency in ownership of radio and television companies
forslag_text:
The Riksdag rejects motion 

2022/23:7 by Malin Björk (C).
notis:
The government has submitted proposals for increased transparency in the ownership of radio and television companies. The Riksdag approved the proposals.
The proposals entail that more providers of media services shall provide information to recipients and that the scope of the information to be provided is expanded compared to what currently applies.
The legislative amendments enter into force on 1 March 2023.
alternatives:
The Riksdag rejects motion 

2022/23:7 by Malin Björk (C).
Dissenting opinion 1

forslag_text:
The Riksdag rejects the motions 

2021/22:4768 by Ali Esbati et al. (V) items 1–8 and 

2021/22:4769 by Elisabeth Svantesson et al. (M) items 1–4 and 

files government communication 2021/22:247.
notis:
In a government communication (skrivelse) the previous government reports on the work of implementing Agenda 2030 and the global goals for sustainable development adopted by the UN General Assembly in 2015.
The communication follows from the Riksdag having, in a formal request (tillkännagivande), called on the government to submit every other year a report on the implementation and target attainment of the work on Agenda 2030. The communication now submitted is the first in the series.
In the communication the previous government assesses that 35 of the 169 sub-targets for achieving Agenda 2030 have been fully attained, or have been attained within Sweden.
For 60 of the sub-targets the previous government assesses that further measures are needed. For 21 of the sub-targets data were lacking to make an assessment.
The Riksdag welcomes the communication and notes that considerable progress has been made with regard to the goals, both within Sweden and globally. The Riksdag further notes that Sweden has a good starting position and better conditions for achieving the global goals than many other countries. The Riksdag considers, however, that there is a considerable way still to go for Sweden before the goals are met.
The Riksdag filed the communication — that is, closed the matter.
alternatives:
The Riksdag rejects the motions 

2021/22:4768 by Ali Esbati et al. (V) items 1–8 and 

2021/22:4769 by Elisabeth Svantesson et al. (M) items 1–4 and 

files government communication 2021/22:247.
Dissenting opinion 1
